To enhance customer communication in a meaningful and scalable way, the support macro should be made shorter and easier to scan. The current version attempts to explain every exception, which causes customers to miss the main answer. The revised macro should still mention the refund window so people know the time limit before they click away. More detailed legal wording should remain in the linked policy rather than being repeated in the first response.
